main_text.p: Illustr. Viro, Infantem, (cujus partes ad eundem cum partibus matrīs conjensum cadunt,) non posse quin intra imaginationem & collum vel sinum proprium, (seu potius in toto suo corpore,) eundem spiritūum motum & agitationem quàm mater intra suas corporis partes producit (seu percipit potius) ad amussim observet; at quid opus est, aut qua ratione potius verofimile evadit, infantis spiritus comites habere atomos mori, quas mater imaginationi embryonis (ut loquitur Virillustriss.) transmiserat? Quid opus, inquam, ejusmodi atomis, ad imaginationem Embryonis (quæ certè in Embryone nulla est,) indeque ad certam aliquam partem tradućtis? Quæ ratio verisimilis ejusmodi atomos rei alicujus in matris imaginatione conceptæ, at nequaquam præsentis, quin imò multis milliaribus absentis, aut fortasse ne quidem in universa Mundi plaga præsentis (v. g. si mater hyberno tempore appetat cerasa vel uvas) existentis, quibus impressio fiat infoe-

page.notes: Page is a single column. Text is mostly Latin with long-s and italics as printed; a few words are uncertain (e.g. "vel", "tradućtis") and the last line is cut off at the foot by the gathering signature area ("Aa 5", not transcribed as signature because it sits in the page's lower margin and reads as a gathering mark; it is given in notes only). Final word "infoe-" is a catchword/hyphenated line end and is left as printed.
